column1: # Word pairs careful writers spell more than one way, and the house spelling.
# Counted over a stratified sample of contemporary Persian (Wikipedia, state media,
# news, the UD treebanks, blogs, Common Voice): a spelling is accepted when some
# stratum writes it at least 10% of the time; the house one is what the strata
# prefer on average. Plurals and comparatives keep the ZWNJ.
